title: Tester III - Software Testing (E2E Tester)
description:
**Role description**

Job Summary We are seeking a highly motivated and detail-oriented End-to-End (E2E) Tester to validate complex business processes across multiple applications, systems, and integrations. The ideal candidate will be responsible for designing, executing, and managing E2E testing activities to ensure business workflows function seamlessly across the technology landscape. The candidate should possess strong functional testing expertise, analytical skills, and experience working in Agile environments while collaborating with business stakeholders, developers, architects, and project teams. Key Responsibilities Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories. Develop End-to-End test scenarios, test cases, and test data based on business workflows. Execute System Integration Testing (SIT), End-to-End Testing (E2E), Regression Testing, and support UAT activities. Validate application integrations, interfaces, APIs, databases, and downstream systems. Identify, document, track, and retest defects through closure. Ensure complete test coverage for business-critical processes. Coordinate with Business Analysts, Developers, Product Owners, and Testing Teams. Perform data validation and reconciliation across systems. Participate in defect triage meetings and root cause analysis discussions. Support release validation, deployment testing, and post-production verification. Maintain testing documentation, execution reports, and status updates. Ensure adherence to quality standards and testing best practices. Primary Skills End-to-End (E2E) Testing Functional Testing System Integration Testing (SIT) Regression Testing Test Case Design & Execution Requirement Analysis Defect Management Business Process Validation Test Planning & Documentation Root Cause Analysis Secondary Skills SQL & Database Testing API Testing (Postman, Swagger, SoapUI) Jira / Azure DevOps / HP ALM Agile & Scrum Methodologies Test Data Management Automation Testing Exposure (Selenium, Playwright, Cypress) Release & Environment Management Data Reconciliation & Reporting CI/CD Concepts Domain Knowledge (Healthcare, Banking, Insurance, Retail, etc.)

 **Skills**

Functional Testing, End-to-End Testing, Defect Tracking, Integration Testing, Postman, Issue Analysis, Regression Testing, Requirements Gathering, Test Data Management

 **About UST**  
UST is a global digital transformation solutions provider. For more than 20 years, UST has worked side by side with the world’s best companies to make a real impact through transformation. Powered by technology, inspired by people and led by purpose, UST partners with their clients from design to operation. With deep domain expertise and a future-proof philosophy, UST embeds innovation and agility into their clients’ organizations. With over 30,000 employees in 30 countries, UST builds for boundless impact—touching billions of lives in the process.
